design: Extend v41 with defender-dependent fresh recorded-FGA zone choice. Two conditional binomial models: three vs two, then paint vs midrange given two. Each controls shooter identity and five defender identities. Whole-game five-fold ridge selection only on older three seasons; 2025-26 excluded from hyperparameter selection. Same-season descriptive associations, not causal intent or prospective validation.
prior: Shooter Jeffreys-style 0.5 equivalent trial at training league rate, defender Gaussian sigma grid [0,0.05,0.1,0.2]. Smaller sigma wins ties within 1e-10/trial. Full fits retain intercept plus shooter and five-defender logits; no named-player adjustments, no win/on-off/rank residual fitting.
runtime: Keep v41 make-defense, FT, turnover, rebound, block and workload models. Replace overwritten fixed fresh zone shares with learned conditional zone probabilities. Recompute source shooting-context centering using actual source lineups and FGA only. Putbacks retain existing mechanics. FGA willingness is measured as recorded attempts per defensive minute and zone share, not claimed psychological intent. No independent total-FGA suppression hazard is invented.
validation: All four already-seen seasons, three matching seeds, full schedules plus strict source PBP games, v41 baseline rerun with identical expanded observer. Per-player opponent long/paint/mid attempt shares and make rates, total and zone FGA per48 defensive minutes, on/off, >=500 source minute cohort and all-player exports. Paint means all non-midrange 2PT, not only restricted area. Preserve the midrange residual category.
gates: No adoption unless every season's 30-team PPG MAE of three-seed mean team totals is <= v41 (numerical tolerance 1e-9), expanded defensive errors improve broadly without relying on Wembanyama alone, individual reconstruction and existing wins/net gates are reported. No adoption merely for Wemby rank improvement. A failed candidate remains an explicit unadopted experiment.
